name: api-client
title: API client
description: Envelope-aware axios instance with bearer-token auth, httpOnly refresh-cookie rotation, cross-tab Web Lock single-flight 401 retry, proactive token refresh, and UI-agnostic onError/onSessionExpired hooks.
postInstall: Adjust BASE_URL / storage keys / REFRESH_PATH in src/lib/api-client.ts to match your backend contract.
